planets.name: TOI-561 e
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-561 with a 77.1-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-561 e was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-561. Its orbit and size follow Piotto et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
